L27n832.name: Word piece to brackets
L27n832.description: Fires on word fragments, Georgian script and names; pushes toward closing brackets and quotes such as ) and ].

L27n711.name: Name syllable to plus
L27n711.description: Negative pole fires on name and word openers (Re-, We-, Se-); pushes toward plus-prefixed tokens such as +A and +B.

L27n587.name: Name start to parens
L27n587.description: Negative pole fires on name openers (Domenici, Iberian, Bre-); pushes toward closing paren and semicolon tokens.

L27n1654.name: Stem piece to ur
L27n1654.description: Fires on stems that split a longer technical word (conj-, metall-, cyan-); pushes toward 'ur' and 'URL' tokens.

L27n2479.name: Compound piece to sn
L27n2479.description: Negative pole fires on compound-word pieces (supers-, outs-, odd-); pushes toward 'sn' tokens.

L27n2682.name: Government security terms
L27n2682.description: Fires on words that lead into official or national-security phrases (Homeland, national, Jurisdiction); pushes toward 'sec' and 'security'.

L27n1531.name: Weak scattered, writes reflect
L27n1531.description: Weak, scattered reads (Chariho, Superwoman, 'waves' in water imagery); pushes toward 'reflect' words.

L27n2247.name: Physics terms, writes return
L27n2247.description: Reads quantity 'of' and physics terms (light emission, scintillator, radioactive, Ehrfurt); pushes toward 'return'.

L27n1367.name: Flat weak noise, writes input
L27n1367.description: Near-flat weak firing on random single words (manpower, vocabulary, work); pushes toward 'input'.

L27n632.name: Parentheses and dashes, writes suffixes
L27n632.description: Fires on opening parentheses, dashes and periods mid-sentence; pushes toward verb suffixes like '-ting' and '-ted'.

L27n2781.name: Word-fragment reads, prime writes
L27n2781.description: Reads scattered mid-word fragments of multi-token words (Franc-, Pr-, Bl-); pushes toward 'prime'.
